The line between competing AI ecosystems is officially blurring.

Here are the top AI updates for developers today:

📦 Vercel open-sourced durable-harness, a package built for crash-proof coding agents. By logging every model and tool call, it allows Pi, OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex sessions to resume after crashes, timeouts, and redeploys on Vercel, Postgres, or a local laptop.

☁️ OpenAI models and Codex workflows are coming to Google Cloud. They will be integrated directly into Gemini's Model Garden through the Google Cloud Marketplace.

🤖 Anthropic introduced Claude Duet, an AI agent designed for professionals and small business owners. Launching as a research preview on web, iOS, and Android, it enters as a direct competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots.

🚗 Google expanded conversational Gemini navigation to Apple CarPlay for US drivers today, with a global rollout underway nearly 12 months after its Android Auto launch.

🛡️ OpenAI detailed its approach to working with distribution partners to uphold consistent safeguards and Usage Policies across platforms.

Seeing frontier models cross into rival cloud marketplaces while open-source tooling solves agent state recovery shows how rapidly developer infrastructure is evolving.

Which of these updates will have the biggest impact on your workflow this week?
